articles.title: Romania and Bulgaria Have Completed the Black Sea Maritime Security Hub
articles.summary: Romania and Bulgaria have finalized a joint project to establish a Black Sea Maritime Security Hub. This initiative, to be located in Constanta (Romania) and Varna (Bulgaria), aims to enhance collaborative efforts and strengthen security in the critical Black Sea region. The hub will serve as a vital platform for addressing shared maritime challenges and coordinating defence objectives between the two nations.

articles.title: New Report Cites Surge In Global Nuclear Weapons Spending
articles.summary: The US military successfully test-fired an unarmed intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM), the Minuteman III, from Vandenberg Air Force Base. This routine launch, marked by a light streak across the night sky, demonstrates the readiness, effectiveness, and accuracy of the nation's nuclear deterrent. Such tests are vital for maintaining strategic stability and ensuring the reliability of the US defence arsenal, serving as a key component of national security.

articles.title: Russian attack sets fire to centuries-old religious site in Kyiv, kills rescuers in Kharkiv
articles.summary: Russia launched a large-scale attack on Ukraine, causing fatalities in Kharkiv, including rescue personnel, and killing four in Kyiv. The strikes set apartment buildings ablaze and started a fire at a historic site. This ongoing aggression highlights the severe human cost and widespread destruction in the conflict, underscoring the volatile international security landscape.

articles.title: Israel expects new air defence orders from Europe due to Russia concerns
articles.summary: Israel anticipates increased European demand for its advanced air and missile defence systems, with new contracts expected soon, potentially within weeks. This surge reflects European nations' growing emphasis on bolstering their aerial protection capabilities amidst evolving security landscapes, highlighting the strategic importance of robust defence infrastructure.

articles.title: US Military Pay Calculator
articles.summary: A US Military Pay Calculator has been updated with official 2026 pay tables and Basic Allowance for Housing (BAH) rates. This resource now includes comprehensive details on base pay, BAH housing rates, and special duty pay rates, all categorized by rank. For SSB aspirants, understanding military compensation structures is crucial for career planning and appreciating the financial aspects of defence services.

articles.title: Laravel API: versioned routing with OpenAPI 3.0 docs generated from PHPDoc
articles.summary: This article details a Laravel package designed to streamline API development. It offers features for building versioned APIs, automatically generating comprehensive OpenAPI 3.0 documentation directly from PHP code. Additionally, it provides CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) scaffolding capabilities. This tool significantly enhances efficiency for developers by automating routine tasks involved in creating robust, well-documented web services.

articles.title: Army, Airtel join hands for mobile connectivity in Arunachal Pradesh district
articles.summary: The Indian Army and Bharti Airtel have partnered to strengthen mobile network infrastructure in remote areas of West Kameng district, Arunachal Pradesh. This crucial collaboration aims to enhance connectivity in strategic border regions, benefiting both military personnel and local communities. Such initiatives are vital for bolstering national security, improving operational effectiveness, and contributing to socio-economic development in challenging terrains.

articles.title: Mihir Ahuja Calls Playing An IAF Pilot In Netflix’s Operation Safed Sagar A “Dream Come True”
articles.summary: Actor Mihir Ahuja will star in Netflix's upcoming series "Operation Safed Sagar." The series aims to bring one of the most significant and emotionally charged stories from Indian military history to screen, likely focusing on the air operations during the Kargil War. This production will offer SSB aspirants a valuable perspective on a pivotal defence event and the bravery of the Indian Armed Forces.
